description: §19.16.6 / §32 — a `~` accumulator initialised before a `defer` and read after it is the SAME accumulator (the statements after a `defer` continue the sequence; they are not a new §32.4 context). f(): two(5) sets ~ = 10, `return ~ + 1` = 11; g(): two(4), `let r = ~` = 8. Deferred bodies still run: trace = "DE".
rationale: §19.16.6: the statements after a `defer` continue the enclosing statement sequence; a `~` initialised before the `defer` resolves after it (§32.2), and no E-CG-TILDE-UNRESOLVED fires.
